meta.title: Test Case Summary | Sample App
meta.basis: Code reading and checks against staging
meta.accounts: Test account held by QA, not stored here

cases.steps:
1. Open /login
2. Enter valid email and password
3. Click Sign in
cases.expected: User lands on **/dashboard** and sees a welcome toast.

cases.steps:
1. Enter valid email, wrong password
2. Click Sign in

cases.expected: Login page is shown; protected page does not render.

LGN-002.actual: Page reloads with no message. User cannot tell why sign-in failed. The request returned 401.

LGN-003.actual: Observed: dashboard stays visible after Back; expected result waits for a decision.

LGN-004.need: Provide a mailbox the QA can read.

issue: Wrong password shows no message. The user cannot tell what failed.
fix: Show an inline error under the form. Keep the entered email.
issues.steps: Open /login, enter a wrong password, click Sign in.

cases.precondition: Figma frame Login / Desktop 1440. Tolerance: hex exact, font exact, spacing within 2 px.
cases.steps:
1. Open /login at 1440 px
2. Compare with the frame
cases.expected: Logo, heading **Welcome back**, email, password, **Sign in** button, Forgot password link, in that order.

cases.steps: 1. Read computed styles of heading, body and button

issue: Login heading and button differ from the design. Heading is 20px instead of 24px; button radius is 4px instead of 8px.
fix: Use the design type scale for h1 and the 8px radius token on the primary button.
issues.steps: Open /login at 1440 px and inspect the heading and Sign in button.
